outcome: maternal morbidity (ICU admission, invasive mechanical ventilation, non-invasive ventilation, vasoactive drugs, renal replacement therapy, hysterectomy, length of ICU stay, APACHE II score)
cohort: The cohort consists of all pregnant and postpartum women admitted to the Intensive Care Unit of a tertiary center in northwest China between January 1, 2009, and December 31, 2022.
finding: Postpartum hemorrhage, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and cardiac diseases were identified as the primary reasons for obstetric ICU admissions, with a decreasing trend in maternal mortality over time and stillbirth associated with multiparity and diabetes.
